description: The smallest design on which the multi-clock loop can close: two asynchronous domains, one generated clock, one CDC crossing, one bottleneck per domain. Small enough that clk2fflogic equivalence finishes in seconds, so a candidate can actually be proved and promoted -- which soc_bench is too large to demonstrate.

known_bottlenecks: fast: 8 terms summed by a serial adder chain instead of a balanced tree, so the depth is 8 adders instead of 3
slow: 24-way priority select written as a serial mux cascade, so bit 23 waits on all 23 below it
notes.invariants: rewrites must preserve each domain's latency exactly and be bit-exact. The two datapaths share no signal except through the CDC synchroniser, and may be rewritten independently.
notes.cdc_off_limits: cdc_* and clk_*_div* -- enforced by tools/protect.py before synthesis. See docs/equivalence-contract.md.
notes.purpose: the multi-clock promotion testbed. soc_bench is the objective-6 benchmark and is too large for a bounded proof to close; this one is not.
